verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scoping each user/tenant to a container tag and deleting all of that container's content via API/console when a deletion request comes in (supermemory-docs-12/19/34/40), covering per-entity and full erasure. However, there is no explicit documentation of a single-memory delete endpoint/operation (only add/update via customId is shown), and no independent or hands-on evidence confirming deletion actually works end-to-end. Missing for 10: documented single-memory delete API, and independent/hands-on verification of deletion behavior.
